name: Michelle K.
text: This is so helpful! I staged my living room by following similar tips and we got 3 offers within a week. The key really is decluttering first before anything else.

name: David R.
text: Good advice but honestly I think you're underestimating how much a professional stager is worth. We tried DIY and our place sat for months, then hired someone and sold in 2 weeks.

name: Sarah M.
text: The lighting suggestion is gold. I swapped out all my dark lampshades for white ones and the difference was incredible. Natural light really does matter that much.

name: James T.
text: Question: does this work for smaller homes? Our place is only 900 sq ft and the realtor said it's hard to stage without making it feel cramped. Any specific tips for that?

name: Patricia L.
text: I've been in real estate for 15 years and I'd add that neutralizing your decor is more important than any other single thing. Buyers need to imagine themselves living there, not feel like they're in someone else's home.
